title: build(deps): bump jszip from 3.10.1 to 3.10.2
intent: Routine currency (Dependabot), no security advisory: the GitHub Advisory Database lists no advisory affecting jszip 3.10.1 (the two known jszip advisories, GHSA-36fh-84j7-cv5h and GHSA-jg8v-48h5-wgxg, were fixed in 3.8.0 and 3.7.0). 3.10.2 (published 2026-09-08 by maintainer jkoops, the first release since 3.10.1 in 2022-08) carries three bug fixes: cross-realm binary type detection in getTypeOf, Blob reading via Blob.prototype.arrayBuffer() with an explicit rejection when no reader exists, and TypeScript types for JSZip.defaults.
behavior_change: Lockfile enumerated as JSON against merge base 7685411c (every packages entry compared field by field, not the diff view): 412 -> 412 entries, added=0, removed=0, changed=2. The only package that moved is node_modules/jszip 3.10.1 -> 3.10.2 (version, resolved, integrity; its dependency ranges lie ~3.3.0, pako ~1.0.2, readable-stream ~2.3.6, setimmediate ^1.0.5 are unchanged). The other changed entry is the root package entry, whose dependencies.jszip range moves ^3.10.1 -> ^3.10.2. No other package moves or reverts. Runtime effect in the client: useBulkExport.ts passes Blobs to zip.file(), which now read through Blob.prototype.arrayBuffer() instead of FileReader in browsers that have it (same bytes; FileReader remains the fallback); evidence/zip_loader.ts passes an ArrayBuffer to JSZip.loadAsync(), whose type detection now uses the toString tag (same result for same-realm buffers).

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json: jszip ^3.10.1 -> ^3.10.2. packages/client/package-lock.json: node_modules/jszip 3.10.1 -> 3.10.2 and the root dependency range; nothing else.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency for a maintained dependency that the client uses for bulk export (useBulkExport.ts) and evidence-pack loading (evidence/zip_loader.ts); no other open PR moves jszip.
